clue.text: Comical PC wasted energy getting a second criminal

indicators.note: wasted, as in ruined or smashed up, tells us to break up and rearrange the letters of the words beside it

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A clownish police constable, his energy squandered, ends up with a criminal partner on his hands.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wasted' rearranges COMICALPC; E for energy follows.
explanation.definitionFit: An accomplice is a partner in crime, the extra wrongdoer who helps the main one.

clue.text: Good hospital introduced by a devotee of Asian country

indicators.note: introduced by means brought in, so good and hospital go inside the devotee word

parts.note: a fan is a devotee
H is the map abbreviation for hospital

explanation.surface: A fan of an Asian country brings in a good hospital.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means belonging to Afghanistan, the country of Central Asia.

clue.text: Additional material in heart — subject of autopsy

indicators.note: in means the additional material is placed inside the heart word

parts.note: the core is the heart of something
PS, postscript, is extra matter added to a letter

explanation.surface: Extra tissue found in the heart during a post-mortem.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heart' looks anatomical in the autopsy scene, but it is CORE.
explanation.definitionFit: An autopsy is carried out on a dead body, so the body is what it examines.

clue.text: Computer hardware represented in enigmatic CDs?

indicators.note: represented means shown again in another form, so the letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: Is that computer kit hidden in some mysterious compact discs?
explanation.definitionFit: A magnetic disc, such as a floppy or hard drive platter, is physical storage in a computer.

clue.text: Malformed sound is evident in recording

indicators.note: in tells us the word is goes inside the recording

parts.note: an LP is a long-playing record

explanation.surface: A speech defect becomes obvious on a recording.
explanation.definitionFit: A lisp is a speech impediment that distorts the s sound.

clue.text: Settling point, one Government restricts crime

parts.note: a colon is a punctuation point

indicators.note: restricts means hems in, so the crime word is held between one and government

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
sin is a wrong or crime

explanation.surface: A point of settlement, where the government keeps crime in check.
explanation.definitionFit: Colonising is settling in a new territory and establishing a community there.

clue.text: Repeated statement backing Church House

indicators.note: backing means going backwards, so the abbreviation for church is read in reverse

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A slogan repeated in support of a church-run house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Repeated statement' fits a slogan in the surface, but an echo is exactly a repeated sound.
explanation.definitionFit: An echo is a sound or remark repeated back, as a reflection of the original.

clue.text: Stately home, cold, inhabited — one should go for energy

indicators.note: should go for means one item is swapped out for another

parts.note: lived in means inhabited
I is the Roman numeral one
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A chilly stately home, lived in, needs one more for heating.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one should go for energy' swaps the second I of LIVED IN for E. Cliveden is a stately home in Buckinghamshire, famous for the Profumo affair.
explanation.definitionFit: Cliveden is a grand country house in England, the kind called a stately home.

clue.text: Stop after work, say, developing public access events

indicators.note: after means the stop word comes after the work word

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work
an end is a stop

indicators.note: developing means changing form, so the letters of say are rearranged

explanation.surface: Knock off after work, so to speak, while public access events develop.
explanation.definitionFit: Open days are occasions when institutions let the public in to look round.

clue.text: Storm about fashions initially available in second-hand event

indicators.note: about means around, so the storm word is wrapped round the other pieces

parts.note: a gale is a storm of strong wind
rages are crazes or fashions (all the rage)

indicators.note: initially picks out the opening letter of the word after it

explanation.surface: A storm blows over the latest fashions on offer at a second-hand sale.
explanation.definitionFit: At a garage sale people sell their used belongings, often from the garage or driveway of the home.

clue.text: Biography, or story about fellow

indicators.note: about here means surrounding, so the story word goes round the fellow

parts.note: a lie is a made-up story

explanation.surface: Is a biography true, or just a tall tale about some chap?
explanation.definitionFit: A life is a written account of someone's career, as in 'a life of Johnson'.

clue.text: Instrument on board with siren? One's bang on target

indicators.note: on as in on board ship: the instrument is placed inside the ship abbreviation

parts.note: board stands for a ship, abbreviated SS for steamship, the vessel you go on board
a harp is a musical instrument
a hooter is a siren or horn

explanation.surface: A harp on a ship along with a siren, like a mythical sea scene.
explanation.definitionFit: A marksman whose shots land exactly on the mark is an expert shot.

clue.text: Australian state, with little hesitation, linked to capital of Australia for solution

indicators.note: linked to joins the pieces into one chain
capital here means the capital letter at the head, so take the first letter of the word

parts.note: NSW is New South Wales
er is a brief noise of hesitation

explanation.surface: A geography question about an Australian state and its capital, answered after some hesitation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital of Australia' is not Canberra but the letter A.
explanation.definitionFit: A solution is the reply to a problem or puzzle, which is what an answer gives.

clue.text: Male absorbed by plan, ultimately

indicators.note: absorbed by means taken inside, so the male word sits within the plan word

parts.note: to intend is to plan
he is the male pronoun

explanation.surface: A man finally gets caught up in the scheme.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means finally or eventually, an idiom equivalent to the single adverb.

clue.text: Suddenly appear as stand-in for someone having a bit of a rest?

definitions.meaning: to come out of hiding, as game does when it bolts from undergrowth

definitions.text: stand-in for someone having a bit of a rest
definitions.meaning: cover provided during a worker's break, read literally

explanation.surface: Emerging suddenly as a substitute for a colleague on a break.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means leave a hiding place, and read literally it is cover during a break.

clue.text: Medical intervention a conflation of mercy and rigours?

indicators.note: a conflation fuses two things together, so the letters of the two words are blended into a new order

explanation.surface: An operation that combines compassion with harsh rigour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a conflation of' mixes MERCY and RIGOURS together.
explanation.definitionFit: Microsurgery is delicate surgery done under a microscope, a type of medical procedure.

clue.text: Steps leading to excessive climbing? That's the point

indicators.note: leading to puts the steps word first, ahead of the next piece

parts.note: a stile is a set of steps over a fence

indicators.note: climbing in a down clue means reading upwards, so the letters are reversed

parts.note: OTT is over the top, excessive

explanation.surface: Steps that lead to too much climbing: exactly the point.
explanation.walkthrough: 'That's the point' reads as a closing remark, but it defines a dagger with a sharp tip.
explanation.definitionFit: A stiletto is a dagger with a narrow blade tapering to a sharp tip.

clue.text: Creation of marriage poem not working

indicators.note: not means without, so the working word is removed

parts.note: a union is a marriage
on means working, as with a switched-on machine
verse is poetry

explanation.surface: Writing a wedding poem that doesn't come off.
explanation.definitionFit: Creation means everything that has been created, the whole cosmos.

clue.text: Safe with endnotes, possibly — musical notes not appreciated with this

definitions.text: musical notes not appreciated with this

indicators.note: possibly signals that the letters could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: Footnotes kept safe, alongside a remark about music falling on deaf ears.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone with this condition cannot tell pitches apart, so melodies are lost on them.

clue.text: Stop rising anger in capsule

indicators.note: in tells us the reversed anger goes inside the capsule word

parts.note: a pod is a capsule, as in an escape pod

indicators.note: rising in a down clue means reading upwards, so the anger word is reversed

parts.note: ire is anger

explanation.surface: Halt the anger building up inside the space capsule.
explanation.definitionFit: A full stop in punctuation is called a period in American usage.

clue.text: Died, being given disruptive parachute

parts.note: rogue as an adjective means behaving erratically and causing trouble

explanation.surface: Someone died after being handed a faulty parachute.
explanation.definitionFit: A drogue is a small parachute used to slow or stabilise an aircraft or capsule.

clue.text: Suffering regarding heart beat, fellows heading off to be confined

indicators.note: to be confined means to be shut inside, so the fellows go inside the beat word

parts.note: to lick is to beat or thrash

indicators.note: heading off means the first letter is removed

parts.note: coves is old slang for chaps or fellows

explanation.surface: Heartache, beatings and men locked up: a grim prison tale.
explanation.walkthrough: Coves is old British slang for men or chaps.
explanation.definitionFit: Being pining with love is an affliction of the heart, so the definition is a fair paraphrase.

clue.text: Chamber regrets backing dilettante

parts.note: a po is a chamber pot

indicators.note: backing means going backwards, so the regrets word is reversed

parts.note: to rue is to regret

explanation.surface: A council chamber regrets having supported an amateur.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Chamber' suggests a council or parliament, but here it is a chamber pot, PO.
explanation.definitionFit: A poseur is a person who affects knowledge or taste, much as a dabbler or amateur pretends to expertise.

clue.text: Crest's curved shape punctured by river

indicators.note: punctured by means pierced, so the river letter goes inside the curved shape

parts.note: a bow is a curved shape, like an archer's bow

explanation.surface: A crest's curved outline pierced by a river.
explanation.definitionFit: The brow of a hill is its top, the crest over which the ground drops.

clue.text: Quantity of tuition yielding some better minds

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A spell of schooling producing some brighter minds.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'yielding' into the definition, but it is only the link joining definition to wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A school term is a period of teaching, a fixed amount of instruction time.

clue.text: Malnourished but tucking into — say — the lot

indicators.note: tucking into means being placed inside, so the malnourished words go within the abbreviation

parts.note: EG means for example, which is what say means
very thin describes someone underfed

explanation.surface: Someone starving and yet tucking into the whole spread.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tucking into' hints at eating, but it puts VERY THIN inside EG.
explanation.definitionFit: The lot is an informal phrase for all of something, meaning the whole thing.

clue.text: Finished line from girlfriend?

indicators.note: from here means taken away from, so the line letter is removed from the girlfriend word

parts.note: a lover is a girlfriend or boyfriend

explanation.surface: A curt break-up message from a girlfriend: it's over.
explanation.definitionFit: Over means ended or done, as in 'the game is over'.

clue.text: Defensive element in card game after selection of cards?

indicators.note: after means the card game word comes after the selection word

parts.note: in draw poker the draw is the cards taken to replace discards
bridge is a card game for four players

explanation.surface: A defensive tactic in bridge after picking cards.
explanation.definitionFit: A drawbridge over a moat could be raised to keep attackers out of a castle.
